name: Greenland
summary: Two horizontal bands of white and red with a counterchanged disc slightly toward the hoist, red over white. The only Nordic flag without a cross, it shows the sun setting over the ice cap.
origin: Greenland gained home rule within the Kingdom of Denmark in 1979. In a 1985 competition, Thue Christiansen's design narrowly beat a green and white Nordic cross. It was adopted on 21 June 1985, Greenland's National Day.

colors.name: White
colors.meaning: The ice sheet (upper band) and icebergs and pack ice (lower half of the disc).

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The ocean (lower band) and the sun (upper half of the disc).

symbols.name: Counterchanged disc
symbols.description: A circle, red on top and white below, overlapping both bands.
symbols.meaning: The sun setting over the ice cap, with the reflection of the ocean; also the return of the sun after the polar night.

facts: It is the only flag of a Nordic country or territory without a Nordic cross.
Its colours match the Danish Dannebrog.
National Day, 21 June, is the longest day of the year.
clues: White over red with a half-red, half-white disc.
The only Nordic flag without a cross.
Its disc is the sun setting over an ice cap.
